## Root Cause & Drill-Down

**Association only — not a causal claim.** The charts below describe how review scores and freight costs are distributed across delivery-severity buckets. This is descriptive, pattern-level reporting only — no claim is made about what determines review scores or freight cost. Use the drill-down tables below to move from a pattern to the underlying seller, location, or order rows.

native.query: SELECT review_score, delivery_severity, count(*) AS order_count FROM fct_orders GROUP BY review_score, delivery_severity ORDER BY review_score, delivery_severity

card.description: Association only — not a causal claim. Cross-tab of order counts by review_score and delivery_severity, straight GROUP BY from fct_orders. This is a descriptive association only, with no claim about what determines review scores.
card.name: Review Score by Delivery Severity

native.query: SELECT delivery_severity, avg(freight_ratio) AS avg_freight_ratio, avg(total_freight_value) AS avg_freight_value, avg(delay_days) AS avg_delay_days, count(*) AS order_count FROM fct_orders GROUP BY delivery_severity ORDER BY delivery_severity

card.description: Association only — not a causal claim. Average freight_ratio, total_freight_value, and delay_days grouped by delivery_severity, order-level, straight GROUP BY from fct_orders. Descriptive association only.
card.name: Freight Ratio by Delivery Severity (Order-Level, from fct_orders)

native.query: SELECT oi.order_id, oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, oi.seller_id, oi.price, oi.freight_value, oi.shipping_limit_date, o.order_status, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_estimated_delivery_date, o.delay_days, o.delivery_severity, o.review_score, o.customer_city, o.customer_state FROM fct_order_items oi JOIN fct_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE oi.seller_id = {{seller_id}} ORDER BY o.order_purchase_timestamp DESC

card.description: Row-level, one row per order item, filtered to a single seller_id. Sourced from fct_order_items joined to fct_orders.
card.name: Seller Drill-Down (Order Items, from fct_order_items joined to fct_orders)

native.query: SELECT order_id, customer_id, customer_city, customer_state, order_status, order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date, delay_days, delivery_severity, review_score, total_price, total_freight_value, freight_ratio FROM fct_orders WHERE 1=1 [[AND customer_city = {{city}}]] [[AND customer_state = {{state}}]] ORDER BY order_purchase_timestamp DESC

card.description: Row-level, one row per order, filterable by customer city and/or state, sourced directly from fct_orders raw customer_city/customer_state columns (no dim_location join).
card.name: Location Drill-Down (Orders, from fct_orders)

native.query: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_status, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_estimated_delivery_date, o.delay_days, o.delivery_severity, o.review_score, o.customer_city, o.customer_state, o.total_price, o.total_freight_value, o.freight_ratio, oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, oi.seller_id, oi.price, oi.freight_value FROM fct_orders o JOIN fct_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_id = {{order_id}} ORDER BY oi.order_item_id

card.description: Row-level, one row per order item, filtered to a single order_id. Sourced from fct_orders joined to fct_order_items.
card.name: Order Drill-Down (Order + Line Items, from fct_orders joined to fct_order_items)

description: Dashboard 3 — answers why are we seeing these problems. Cross-tabs review score against delivery severity and freight cost against delivery performance, plus row-level drill-downs by seller, location, and order. Built entirely on fct_orders and fct_order_items.
name: Root Cause & Drill-Down
